items.source: The cluster ordering of this column if type() is PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED, otherwise ignored. Default is Ordering.ASCENDING.
items.translation: 如果此列的type()为PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED，则使用此列的顺序；否则忽略。默认值为Ordering.ASCENDING。

items.source: Identifies the annotated field of a composite primary key class as a primary key field that is either a partition or cluster key field. Annotated properties must be either reside in a PrimaryKeyClass to be part of the composite key or annotated with Id to identify a single property as primary key column.
items.translation: 将复合主键类中的注解字段识别为分区键或聚簇键的主键字段。作为复合键一部分的注解属性必须位于PrimaryKeyClass中，或者使用Id进行注解以标识单个属性为主键列。

items.source: The cluster ordering of this column if type() is PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED, otherwise ignored.
items.translation: 如果该列的type()为PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED，则指定其簇排序；否则忽略此设置。

items.source: The type of this key column. Default is PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED.
items.translation: 该主键列的类型。默认为PrimaryKeyType.CLUSTERED。

items.source: The type of this key column.
